modern: Men despise one another and flatter one another; and men wish to raise themselves above one another, and grovel before one another.
original: Men despise one another and flatter one another; and men wish to raise themselves above one another, and crouch before one another.

notification_original: Men despise one another and flatter one another; and men wish to raise themselves above one another, and crouch before one another.

explained.summary: A blunt observation about how people behave: they look down on each other and flatter each other, try to climb over each other and grovel to each other. Contempt and sycophancy turn out to be two sides of the same habit of measuring yourself against others instead of simply treating them well.
